extracted.name: Tomato & black bean taco salad
extracted.description: Enjoy this refreshing taco salad on a warm evening when you’re craving something quick, fresh and crunchy, or as a side for a Mexican-style feast
ingredient_lines: 1 jalapeño pepper (deseeded if you prefer less heat), finely chopped
400g can black beans drained and rinsed
instruction_lines: Combine the lime juice, coriander, cumin, jalapeño and oil in a bowl. Season well.

Tip in the beans, tomatoes, lettuce, corn and red pepper. Toss to combine. Crumble in the taco shells and mix to coat everything in the dressing. Scatter over the pumpkin seeds and serve straightaway.
